stop_rules.ordinary_semantic_or_structure_failure: Preserve the failed independent API sample and continue the frozen remaining independent API plan without repair or retry. A failed Chrome dependency stops the remainder of that chain; do not manufacture state.
stop_rules.execution_failure: Pause on ledger persistence, version/payload mismatch, authentication/permission, quota/rate limit, timeout/network or sent-cancellation uncertainty; do not probe or resume automatically.
stop_rules.chrome_version_deviation: Stop the chain when any expected revision, city, batch, confirmed identity or prerequisite differs. No manual seed/fixup can make the remaining Chrome operations count as the original chain.
stop_rules.paid_model_limit: At 12 physical attempts stop. Each planned operation is occupied before dispatch; uncertain attempts remain occupied after restart.
stop_rules.poi_limit: All actual searches, including model mistakes, consume the six logical/twelve physical bound. Cancel optional manual searches first; do not exceed the limit or use them as replacement successes.
stop_rules.closing: No chat-3 implementation, no production deployment/migration and no new allowance. A batch is limited evidence, not general model reliability or nationwide POI availability.
